testcase.name: a guard-skipped duplicate's PREPARED effect is failed, not left orphaned
durable path never creates a speculative runner even when enabled
a same-batch third duplicate stops the run and terminalizes the rejected effects
guard rebuild counts a finished effect so a re-emitted signature skips across runs
an approval-parked PREPARED emission still executes on durable resume
a finished callId re-emitted under the same id is not re-executed on the durable path
non-durable path still wires the speculative runner when enabled
same toolCallId with different args fails closed instead of binding the old effect
